coverage_assessment: Non-exhaustive open-web first pass after 12 logged searches: 17 candidate leads, 1 documented exclusion, and 58 unique source URLs (19 opened, including coordinator-opened records; 39 search-only). Coverage includes English and Nepali searches, national and local contemporary reporting, an opened secondary timeline, and official NHRC statements. Attendance thresholds, some primary-source checks, event identity, response attribution, physical ends, month boundaries, and sustained province and sector breadth remain incomplete. This dossier is not an exhaustive archive search; the official baseline remains unresolved.
